scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build:web && npm --prefix desktop run dist -- --win
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build:web && npm --prefix desktop run dist -- --mac
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run build:web && npm --prefix desktop run dist -- --linux
